oasr: Option-Adjusted Spread Analysis for Fixed Income Securities

Source: R/oasr-package.R
oasr-package.Rd

A comprehensive toolkit for option-adjusted spread (OAS) analysis of fixed income securities with embedded options. Provides functions for modeling prepayments, defaults, and interest rates to calculate accurate option-adjusted spreads. Supports various prepayment and default models, including CPR (Conditional Prepayment Rate), CDR (Conditional Default Rate), and time-to-event survival models. Leverages the 'dnsr' package for interest rate modeling and yield curve simulation.

Details

The main entry points are:

  • simulate_rates: interface with dnsr for interest rate simulation

  • prepayment_model: create prepayment model specifications

  • calculate_credit_vectors: project prepayment, default and recovery rates

  • project_cashflows: project cash flows under each rate path

  • calculate_oas: solve for the option-adjusted spread

  • run_oas_sensitivity: perform sensitivity analysis
